original_test_intent: Validate each Type 20 Partition Row Position as the device's position within its memory row, including reserved/unknown encodings, device width and complete Type 17/19/20 row membership before and after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 17/19/20 records, bind the raw row-position byte to its device and mapped range, decode version-specific reserved/unknown values, compare non-reserved positions with approved row membership/device width, and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user defines expected row topology/encoding policy and approves reboot; no interleave reconfiguration or physical DIMM action is intrinsic.
required_inputs: SMBIOS version/field semantics and structure length
Expected row membership, numbering and device widths
Resolved Type 17 device and Type 19 range topology
Reserved zero/unknown FFh and logical/soldered memory policy
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/OS-map collection; never alter DIMMs, channels, interleaving, firmware or kernel.
Preserve raw row byte and distinguish reserved/unknown from valid positions.
Resolve device/range handles and validate positions as a complete row set rather than isolated numbers.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on topology contradiction or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode each raw row position, resolve its device/range, construct row-slot sets, validate positions against approved membership/width and compare pre/post reboot.
Report reserved, unknown, duplicate, missing or drifting positions without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve row membership/numbering, width and special-memory policy plus reboot plan.
Interpret platform-specific logical row layouts and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot retain raw encodings, resolve device/range or prove row-slot completeness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full Type 17/19/20 data; report each device/range, raw/decoded row position, reserved/unknown state, row-slot membership/width result and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Partition Row Position scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no topology change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve and version-decode every raw row-position byte, resolve device/range handles, build complete row-slot groups, validate against approved device widths/membership and compare after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS systems exposing Type 20 row positions.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 20 Partition Row Position and Type 17/19 relationship definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw reserved/unknown decoding, row grouping and topology completeness.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects reserved values passed as positions, duplicate/missing row slots and wrong-device membership missed by grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved row topology, widths and encoding policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Row position is topology metadata and must not be inferred from physical slot order without platform mapping.

project_override_considerations: A project may define logical/soldered or non-interleaved row behavior, but must document row membership and reserved/unknown acceptance; it cannot treat any numeric decoder output as self-validating.
expected_evidence: Approved row membership/numbering, device-width and encoding policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17/19/20 records with versions/lengths
Per-device/range raw/decoded row position and full row-slot map
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot row-map diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Partition Row Position is a valid Type 20 field; expected row topology is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw decoding, handle resolution and row-set validation are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw encoding, device/range identity and complete row-slot topology validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains topology safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps missing topology/reboot inputs as readiness and engineer verdict separate.

review_improvement: Prevents an isolated row number from passing when it is reserved, duplicated, missing peers or assigned to the wrong device/range.
independent_technical_reasoning: Version-aware byte decoding and row-set comparison are deterministic read-only operations; owner topology supplies expectations without manualizing the core.
